(module scope)

The composited modal surface the strip-warp backends sample. Coordinates of mediaBox/clipBox are content-local CSS px — the texture ctx carries the dpr/scale transform, so every stamp (bake and per-frame restamp alike) draws in CSS px.

tex

The baked texture canvas — null means "no surface", the warp ghosts.

ctx

The texture's 2D context — the live restamp writes into it.

media

Primary restamp source — the modal's media item. A

back

Standby restamp source — the video's poster primed as an off-DOM Image; fills the media box until the video reports real pixels. Drops after its first stamp.

mediaBox

Content-local CSS-px box the media item occupies (contain-fit inside).

clipBox

Content-local CSS-px clip — the figure's rounded rect.

clipRadius

The figure's corner radius (CSS px) applied to the restamp clip.

dimsOf

Intrinsic pixel dims of a drawable — naturalWidth for images, videoWidth for video.

posterSource

  • @param el The media element — poster only exists on
  • @returns The primed image, or null when no poster is set.

fitContain

Contain-fits a source into a box — mirrors the media item's object-fit: scale-down so the baked frame lands exactly where the letterboxed pixels live (not stretched across the item's box). The , 1) in the scale is the scale-down half of the contract: a source smaller than its box draws at natural size, never upscaled — the same guarantee the modal's CSS gives the live element. Writes into out (a scratch rect — no allocation per call).

  • @param sw Source pixel width.
  • @param sh Source pixel height.
  • @param box The item's content-local box.
  • @param out Scratch rect receiving the fitted draw box.

stampFigure

Stamps the media figure: the figure's background + rounded-corner clip, the placeholder layer, then the media item contain-fitted. Returns the geometry the renderer needs for per-frame restamps (the item's box, the figure clip, the corner radius) — all content-local CSS px.

  • @param ctx The texture context.
  • @param content The modal content root.
  • @param ox Content-local origin x.
  • @param oy Content-local origin y.
  • @param out Scratch rect for fit math (reused per call).
  • @returns The figure geometry, or null when the figure is absent.

buildGenieSheet

Bakes the bounded modal card into an offscreen canvas — the sheet the genie funnel warps. The extent is the media-figure rect (the "window" — reference-faithful): its opaque frame, rounded clip, placeholder and media item, all figure-local. The fullscreen glass veil and viewport chrome stay out of the texture and fade under .expand-modal-genie-veil while the funnel flies. One layout pass (batched rect + style reads), one canvas, ~a dozen draw calls; the result is a stable texture so the per-frame work stays a pure strip resample. The texture long edge caps at GENIE_WARP.TEX_MAX_PX — enough sharpness for a 700ms warp without an unbounded framebuffer.

  • @param content The modal content root (the figure lives inside it).
  • @param dpr The overlay's device-pixel cap (already clamped).
